scope: Pinned partition init/find/cache: seven exact records, all readiness bytes, all missing-device masks, signed offset/device-length boundaries, partial cache effects and count mutation, native error printf, lookup strings and terminal assertion, guards/registers
limitations: Device lookup and printf are controlled callbacks; real FAL device/driver and runtime output remain gates.
Only mapped bounded tables/names are covered; invalid/null strcmp pointers and cache overflow are not portable contracts.
Instruction identity, whole image and hardware remain unproven.
